banner.description: Marigolds, offerings and living traditions. Discover a different side of San Luis Potosí, from the capital to the Huasteca.

status.title: Plan the season, confirm the program
status.description: This is a cultural guide for 2026. Municipal dates, venues, performances and activities are pending official confirmation. October 31–November 2 refers to the traditional season, not a confirmed 2026 event schedule.

intro.title: Memory is a living tradition.
intro.description: In the Huasteca, Xantolo is a way of welcoming the memory of those who have died. Offerings, food, music and dance connect families and communities. Each community gives the tradition its own meaning; arrive as a respectful guest.

places.title: Two ways to discover the season

capital.title: San Luis Potosí capital
capital.description: Look for cultural activities and public offerings in the city’s official program. These urban celebrations are distinct from the community rituals of the Huasteca.

huasteca.title: Huasteca Potosina
huasteca.description: Discover the tradition in its community setting. Choose a destination, contact local hosts or guides and confirm which activities welcome visitors before traveling.

offerings.title: Altars & offerings
offerings.description: Flowers, candles and food honor loved ones. Ask before photographing an altar or entering a family space.

dance.title: Music & dance
dance.description: Community dances and music form part of the season. Respect the performers, their space and each community’s rules.

food.title: Food & memory
food.description: Shared food accompanies remembrance. Support local cooks and ask what each offering means.

remembrance.title: Time to remember
remembrance.description: Cemetery visits and offerings are acts of remembrance. Keep your distance from private moments and ask permission before taking photos.

transport.title: Choose your base
transport.description: The capital and the Huasteca require different travel plans. Confirm accommodation, road conditions and your return transport with local providers.

essentials.title: Bring the essentials
essentials.description: Pack water, comfortable shoes, sun protection and a light rain layer. Check the weather for your destination before leaving.

family.title: Set your own pace
family.description: With children or older relatives, plan breaks, a meeting point and your return before evening activities. Ask about access and walking distances.

sources.title: Learn from the sources
sources.description: Cultural context: INAH and Mexico’s Ministry of Culture. For current programs, consult state and municipal organizers.

seo.title: Xantolo 2026 & Day of the Dead in San Luis Potosí
seo.description: Explore Xantolo and Day of the Dead in San Luis Potosí: Huasteca traditions, the capital, respectful travel and official program updates.
